r3_reuse.reason: R3 uses a separately trained local 40-class CNN-attention phone classifier and separately calibrated margins. Combining its decisions with R5 CTC scores would mix models, units, windows, and calibration histories.
r3_reuse.acceptable_concept: A substitution is an expected position replaced by another canonical phone.
r3_reuse.preferred_mechanism: Construct exact CTC substitution sequences directly under the frozen R4/R5 acoustic logits so every competitor shares one likelihood and normalization space.

exact_construction.DELETE: for each expected position i, E[:i] + E[i+1:]
exact_construction.SUBSTITUTION: for each expected position i, replace E[i] with each canonical phone q != E[i]
exact_construction.BEST_SUB_tie: lowest canonical phone index within the frozen R4 per-position comparison

r4_reuse.code_reuse_boundary: Hypothesis constructors, phone vocabulary, batching pattern, and TARGET formula can inform new R5-2 code without changing frozen R4 artifacts or conclusions.
r4_reuse.required_safety_change_for_new_generatio: R4 code counted minimum CTC steps but relied on zero_infinity=True. Any new implementation must apply R5-1A alignability-safe impossible-target semantics before interpreting loss. This is new R5-2 code, not a modification of R4.

reusable_mechanisms: minimum CTC steps and adjacent-repeat count
not_reusable_as_r5_2_evidence: R5-1A threshold as an R5-2 threshold
R5-1B predictions or metrics for formula selection
R5-1C findings as a tuning set
